title: DAI Assistant
tagline: A modern web application that provides intelligent AI agents to help users manage their digital life through secure OAuth integrations with various services like Gmail, Google Calendar, and ride-sharing platforms.
description: Our platform revolutionizes email management by combining the power of artificial intelligence with blockchain security. We've created a next-generation email assistant that not only helps users manage their communications more efficiently but also ensures unprecedented levels of security and authenticity through blockchain integration.
how_its_made:
## Core Features

### 1. AI-Powered Email Management
- Smart Categorization: Automatically sorts and prioritizes emails using advanced AI algorithms
- Intelligent Responses: Generates context-aware email responses
- Automation Workflows: Creates custom rules for handling repetitive tasks

### 2. Blockchain Integration
- Decentralized Storage: Emails are securely stored on the blockchain
- Cryptographic Verification: Every email is cryptographically signed
- Smart Contract Automation: Automated workflows powered by blockchain
- Web3 Wallet Integration: Seamless connection with major crypto wallets

### 3. Security Features
- End-to-End Encryption: Military-grade encryption for all communications
- Immutable Audit Trail: Blockchain-based record keeping
- SOC 2 Compliance: Enterprise-level security standards
- GDPR & CCPA Compliance: Full regulatory compliance

### 4. Technical Stack
- Frontend: Next.js 13 with App Router
- Styling: Tailwind CSS for modern, responsive design
- Blockchain: Ethereum (Layer 1) with Layer 2 scaling solutions
- Storage: IPFS for decentralized storage
- Authentication: Dynamic.xyz for Web3 wallet integration
- Smart Contracts: Solidity for automated workflows

## Key Benefits

### For Users
- Enhanced email security and privacy
- Efficient email management with AI assistance
- Verifiable communication history
- User-friendly interface with Web3 capabilities

### For Enterprises
- Immutable audit trails for compliance
- Enhanced security measures
- Automated workflow solutions
- Integration with existing systems
